_om: Hjerteknuseren in English (Heartbreaker, rusj.no/en/heartbreaker/). Key = the Norwegian text in spill.js. Shared words (Nytt spill, Alle spill …) come from rusj/kit/tekst.en.json.
Mobilene legger det som passer, helt til: The phones play whatever fits, completely at random. Good for learning.
Mobilene gir bort farlige kort, dukker u: The phones pass on dangerous cards, duck under and dump the queen of spades when they can.
Mobilene husker hvert kort, jager spar d: The phones remember every card, flush out the queen of spades and stop anyone trying to shoot the moon.
En kort kamp: når noen har 50 poeng, vin: A short game: when someone reaches 50 points, whoever has the fewest wins.
Vanlig lengde: når noen har 100 poeng, v: The usual length: when someone reaches 100 points, whoever has the fewest wins.
You got the queen of spades – 13 points.
{navn} got the queen of spades – 13 points.
Gi tre kort {retning} – til {navn}. Valg: Pass three cards {retning} – to {navn}. Chosen: {n} of 3.
You have the two of clubs – lead with it.
Din tur – spill ut et kort. Hjerter er i: Your turn – lead a card. Hearts aren't broken yet.
Du har ingen {farge} – legg hva du vil,: You've no {farge} – play anything, but no points in the first trick.
Du har ingen {farge} – kvitt deg med noe: You've no {farge} – get rid of something!
You shot the moon! Everyone else gets 26.
{navn} shot the moon! Everyone else gets 26.
Ingen poeng på deg denne runden!: No points for you this round!
Du mot tre mobiler. Unngå hjerter og spa: You against three phones. Avoid the hearts and the queen of spades. When someone reaches the limit, whoever has the fewest points wins.
Før hver runde gir alle tre kort: først: Before each round everyone passes three cards: first to the left, then to the right, then across the table. Every fourth round everyone keeps their cards.
Den som har kløver to, spiller ut. Har d: Whoever has the two of clubs leads. If you have cards in the suit that was led, you must play one of them. The highest card of that suit takes the trick and leads next.
Hver hjerter du tar, gir ett poeng, og s: Every heart you take costs a point, and the queen of spades 13. The fewest points is best.
Har du ikke fargen, kan du legge hva du: If you don't have the suit, you can play anything – a fine chance to get rid of the queen of spades or a heart.
Du kan ikke spille ut hjerter før noen h: You can't lead hearts until someone has played a heart on a trick (hearts are ‘broken’), unless you only have hearts left.
I første stikk kan ingen legge hjerter e: Nobody may play a heart or the queen of spades in the first trick, unless they have nothing else.
Skyte månen: Tar du alle hjerterne og sp: Shooting the moon: take every heart and the queen of spades, and you get 0 while everyone else gets 26.
Ess er høyest, så kommer konge, dame, kn: Aces are high, then king, queen, jack and on down to two.
Gi gjerne bort spar dame, spar ess og sp: It's a good idea to pass on the queen, ace and king of spades – and high hearts.
«Siste stikk» viser hvilke kort som ble: ‘Last trick’ shows the cards played in the trick before.
Follow suit – and steer clear of the hearts.
The queen of spades is the worst.
Well done! The fewest points wins.
Godt kjempa! Neste gang går spar dame ti: Well fought! Next time the queen of spades will go to someone else.
Du har valgt tre – trykk på ett for å by: You've chosen three – tap one to swap it
Jeg slo mobilene i Hjerteknuseren ({niva: I beat the phones at Heartbreaker ({niva}) with only {n} points. Can you get fewer?
Mobilene slo meg i Hjerteknuseren ({niva: The phones beat me at Heartbreaker ({niva}), {stilling}. Can you do better?
Du går til kåringen. Runden du er midt i: You'll go to the results. The round you're in the middle of doesn't count.
You can always start a new one.
